meta.description: Spring of the fifth year of King Clovis IV's reign

current_concern.description: Orc raids from the marsh borderlands have intensified; seeking Sylvaine's aid
current_concern.constraint: Cannot commit fleet to inland defense

current_concern.description: Rochedur's quarrying has crept toward sacred groves; seeking diplomatic resolution
current_concern.constraint: Cannot act hastily without tree ent consensus

current_concern.description: Major ore vein discovered near contested Sylvaine border; preparing expansion
current_concern.constraint: Dwarven advisors urge caution about ancient wards

current_concern.description: Spring thaw threatening key ice-bridge; frost trolls demanding compensation
current_concern.constraint: Limited resources for troll tribute

current_concern.description: Rumors of shadow magic in court; investigating Vallombre's influence
current_concern.constraint: His chivalrous nature limits covert action

current_concern.description: Aquilon's blockade strangling trade; plotting revenge through poison
current_concern.constraint: Orc clans fractious, difficult to unite for action

current_concern.description: Grandmother pressuring for marriage; delaying while managing Rochedur documents threat
current_concern.constraint: Cannot act openly without exposing family secrets

current_concern.description: Volcanic activity increasing; fire elementals restless in the deep
current_concern.constraint: Mountain isolation limits communication with allies

current_concern.description: Aurelian documents discovered that could invalidate Beaumont claims; deciding how to use them
current_concern.constraint: Revealing too early loses leverage

current_concern.description: Ferroigne expansion threatening border wards; preparing illusions to mislead
current_concern.constraint: Elven advisors divided on direct vs. subtle response

current_concern.description: Portrait of grandmother discovered in Lumière; agents dispatched to destroy evidence
current_concern.constraint: Cannot reveal herself or act openly

current_concern.description: River damming dispute with Ferroigne affecting horse grazing lands
current_concern.constraint: Prefers diplomatic resolution to honor swift cavalry tradition

current_concern.description: Obsessing over prophecy that Magister Corvinus claims proves his divine destiny
current_concern.constraint: Cannot distinguish genuine counsel from manipulation

current_concern.description: Ensuring the Ancient Aurelias prophecy serves his unknown agenda
current_concern.constraint: Must maintain appearance of loyal advisor

current_concern.description: Arranging Clovis's marriage; three candidates currently in consideration
current_concern.constraint: Clovis avoids commitment; barons maneuvering

current_concern.description: Concerned about strange visitors Malaric receives at night
current_concern.constraint: Unwavering loyalty prevents voicing suspicion

current_concern.description: Negotiating expanded mining rights in Glacière; frost troll agreements pending
current_concern.constraint: Guild bureaucracy requires formal approval from Irondeep

current_concern.description: Cold war with Nyra Beaumont's network; seeking leverage
current_concern.constraint: Triumvirate Compact limits overt action

key_npcs.name: Magister Corvinus Ashborne

current_concern.description: Feeding Clovis fabricated prophecies; true goal unknown
current_concern.constraint: Must maintain scholarly credibility

key_npcs.disposition: Grandiose, manipulative, believing his own myths

key_npcs.name: Lady Marguerite Beaumont

current_concern.description: Pressuring grandchildren to marry; protecting family secrets
current_concern.constraint: Age limiting travel; relies on proxies

key_npcs.disposition: Sharp as ever, scheming for legacy

active_tensions.description: Aquilon's naval blockade is starving Marécage; Baroness Moreau plots poison revenge
active_tensions.escalation_trigger: Trade vessel attacked or poisoning discovered
active_tensions.resolution_path: Negotiated trade treaty or third party mediation

active_tensions.description: Rochedur quarrying threatens sacred groves; Arborin considers this unforgivable
active_tensions.escalation_trigger: Quarrying reaches the Grove of Whispers

active_tensions.description: Ferroigne's mining expansion disturbs spirits in border ruins
Baron Alain exposed Nyra's lineage; she considers him a primary enemy
Rochedur possesses documents threatening Beaumont legitimacy
active_tensions.escalation_trigger: Documents leaked or used as leverage
active_tensions.resolution_path: Theft, forgery proof, or negotiated silence

active_tensions.description: Cold war for control of Merovingia's shadows between Nyra's network and the Thieves Guild
active_tensions.resolution_path: Territory agreement or one side's defeat

rumors.text: They say Lord Chancellor Malaric has served three kings. Three! How can any man live so long?
The Beaumont cousins have elven blood, you know. That's why they're so... peculiar.
The King has received a prophecy declaring him the greatest ruler since Clovis the First! Great things are coming!
Before the Triumvirate, there was a fourth guild — the Navigators. Some say they still exist, watching from the waves.
The Queen Mother has three brides in mind for Clovis. War might come from whoever is rejected.
Don't eat anything that comes from the marshes. The Baroness Moreau puts poison in everything she exports.
